Orchard project field guide

The Orchard project coordinator is Mira Stone.

Teams must contain between 3 and 5 students.

Registration closes on 14 May 2027.

Orchard project report limits

Advanced category: Reports must not exceed 40 pages.

Orchard project participation

Teams must attend the safety briefing.

Teams may attend the optional mapping workshop.
